rules.says: Every edit comes after the intent is accepted and locked.
Only Deliver edits; answering, investigating and reviewing never change files.
Learning is recorded only from a verification with no edit or amendment since.
Capturing an insight never changes where the delivery stands.
After a review, recording the learning stays possible.

limits: The diagram has no counters or data, so bounds such as edit counts are covered by the workflow-invariant behavior checks, not here.
